set.body:
Current scope

Sequential assessment 2026-09-12: retain P1 independent qualification, but the fixed-support-only premise does not describe all current tests. VolumeSearchlightSuite already covers radius-zero identity, closed boundaries, symmetry/monotonicity, geometry and support selection; SurfaceSearchlightSuite exercises native geodesic neighborhoods. These tests were inspected, not newly run in this assessment. Remaining work is an independent native-neighborhood fixture and end-to-end local-analysis qualification. Match coordinate frames, units, distance metric, masks, center/support identity and ordering before comparing libraries. In particular, do not treat surface geodesic neighborhoods as equivalent to Euclidean volume spheres. Record exact reference versions, boundary/tie policy, local failure behavior, numerical outputs, and separated setup/kernel measurements. No PyMVPA compatibility layer is required.

Original historical scope

The current court proves fixed-support local analyses only. Add a coordinate fixture whose sphere/radius and boundary semantics can be instantiated by PyMVPA's native sphere_searchlight and ScalaFIM's voxel or surface frame builder. Compare ordered center/support identity, local failures, outputs, and setup/kernel performance. Do not add a PyMVPA compatibility layer.
